confidence_notes: Food anchors (cappuccino, beer, inexpensive and mid-range meals) rest on several aggregated estimates, but most come from modelled cost-of-living sites with mixed years (2024 to 2026) and inconsistent exchange-rate assumptions. No current menus were checked. The cocktail anchor rests on one crowd-sourced 2024 average covering downtown clubs, not Lakeside bars. The wine_glass anchor is derived from the local beer and cocktail relationship, not from a direct source. All four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates; no accommodation search was run and no live listings were inspected. The FX observation (0.6947 for 2026-10-16) came from a search-result summary of RBA exchange-rate data, not from a page I opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Primarily Pokhara-specific aggregated estimates for food and drinks. Accommodation and wine_glass use holistic judgement for a Nepali lakeside tourist town at a similar price level. No separate comparable-city search was run. Lakeside tourist-strip pricing is assumed to sit above the rest of town.
